flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck; no OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: A general MHA report (success and error) exists but goes out by email and blob, not an OIC dashboard, and is not warrant-specific (33%).
note: Sinonim dicoba di enam repo (UI dan API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, warrant of arrest, mention date, court date, court batch, last known address, work item, dashboard, OIC. Tidak ada maintenance ticket yang cocok (grep warrant / letter of advice / court = 0). Status story kosong di data (requirement tidak diberikan); dilacak biasa. CasIntegrationController (CAS-ke-OCMS, casUpdateCourtNotices) ada tetapi bukan fitur ini dan tidak dikreditkan: ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101. What exists: MhaReportJob builds an Excel (Summary, Success, Error) then saves to Azure Blob and emails email.report.recipients (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/agencies/mha/report/jobs/MhaReportJob.java:36-41, :56-60, :159-165). The content is notices processed by MHA (RD/DN stages, suspension), not warrant defendants. No OIC dashboard or work item entity/endpoint exists in the six repos. The real email recipients and report cron cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Evidence 33%. Claim only the general MHA report; routing to an OIC dashboard does not exist.

steps.step: OCMS generates a report of defendants whose address was updated
steps.detail: MhaReportJob builds a Success sheet per notice (MhaReportSuccessRow.java:17-25: processing date, stage, notice no, ID). This is the general MHA report, not specific to warrant / Letter of Advice defendants, and it does not carry the new address.

steps.step: OCMS generates an error report (if any) for the address check
steps.detail: The Error sheet lists problem notices with a remark (MhaReportErrorRow.java:17-25). General MHA mechanism, not tied to the warrant flow.

steps.step: The report is routed to the OIC's dashboard
steps.detail: The report is emailed to email.report.recipients and saved to Azure Blob (MhaReportJob.java:56-60, :159-165). No OIC dashboard, work queue or report-list endpoint for the OIC exists in the six repos.
